dialogues.speaker: Sluasi
dialogues.text: Why haven't the materials I ordered before arrived yet...

dialogues.speaker: Sluasi
dialogues.text: Hmm. The accessories you're wearing seem rather strange...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: My accessories?

dialogues.speaker: Sluasi
dialogues.text: Ah, I'm sorry. I'm an artisan — whenever I see ornaments and such that I've never seen before, my mind jumps right to "How do I make that"?

dialogues.speaker: Sluasi
dialogues.text: Ah, yours are so beautiful — simple yet full of charm. I love them.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You spoke of materials you ordered...

dialogues.speaker: Sluasi
dialogues.text: That's right — I mean gems I ordered from a merchant in Fontaine.

dialogues.speaker: Sluasi
dialogues.text: I make all kinds of accessories out of gems, but conversely, I can't do my work without them.

dialogues.speaker: Sluasi
dialogues.text: *sigh* I just wish the goods would come in faster...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I've got some other things to attend to right now...

dialogues.speaker: Sluasi
dialogues.text: Alright then. See you.

dialogues.speaker: Sluasi
dialogues.text: Why haven't the materials I ordered before arrived yet...

dialogues.speaker: Sluasi
dialogues.text: Ah, we meet again. How are things? Would you like to purchase some accessories?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How's the paint-making going?

dialogues.speaker: Sluasi
dialogues.text: They're still in the final adjustment phase. We should be done pretty soon!

dialogues.speaker: Sluasi
dialogues.text: It is taking longer than I thought it would, though... But just like with gems, I have to create the perfect paints.

dialogues.speaker: Sluasi
dialogues.text: If it isn't perfect work, it isn't worth doing. *sigh* If only Puca would understand that sooner...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You spoke of materials you ordered...

dialogues.speaker: Sluasi
dialogues.text: That's right — I refer to gems I ordered from a merchant in Fontaine...

dialogues.speaker: Sluasi
dialogues.text: Just like how it is with the paint-making materials you showed me previously...

dialogues.speaker: Sluasi
dialogues.text: There is much work for a gem artisan like myself that cannot start without source materials.

dialogues.speaker: Sluasi
dialogues.text: Gah, I just wish those goods would come in faster...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: See you.

dialogues.speaker: Sluasi
dialogues.text: Alright then, bye!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the earthquake just a while ago...

dialogues.speaker: Sluasi
dialogues.text: *sigh* To think that Puca's run off at a time like this...

dialogues.speaker: Sluasi
dialogues.text: Well, since she's got friends with her, things can't be too bad, right...?
